notes.title: Our new game + developer community links
notes.content:
Hello! We hope all has been well! We're here with with two bits of news:

1- If you're interesting in chatting it up with us, we've now got a Discord. We've got some new stuff cooking and we'll be sharing news, WIP art and videos, etc in our newly formed [url=discord.gg/MdbVSc2NyE]Robot Invader Discord server[/url]. We'll also be doing the occasional game giveaway and such there. If a newsletter or Twitter is more your thing, we're got those too. So if you're interesting in learning more about our previous games (we have 10!) and being the first to get info and opportunities to playtetst our next one (we're actively working on it!), plus game giveaways, we'd love for you to join our community. Here are the links:
[list]
[*] [url=discord.gg/MdbVSc2NyE]Robot Invader Discord server[/url]
[*] [url=robotinvader.com/newsletter/ ]Robot Invader Newsletter[/url] (promise, no spam!)
[*] [url=https://x.com/robotinvader]Twitter[/url]
[/list]

2- our latest game SEEING THINGS recently launched! Woohoo!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2636340/SEEING_THINGS/utm_source=BB_communityupdate][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12663215/e74d964983935be9cf5a6368a433a8c28792c4f1.png[/img][/url]

It's been a lot of fun seeing players and streamers alike enjoying [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2636340/SEEING_THINGS/utm_source=BB_communityupdate]SEEING THINGS[/url]. It's currently sitting at 100% positive reviews. And if it sounds like it's your thing --it's got the perfect blend of silly and spooky -- we'd love for you to check it out too!

notes.title: Beacon's Bluff 1.04 Update Released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43679181/852c75f730069f5cfdc64deda5dccfc39b193622.gif[/img]
We've released Beacon's Bluff 1.04 Update for Windows and Mac OS!

This update fixes a crash bug experienced by some Windows users on certain graphics cards near the end game.  

It also includes the following improvements:
[list]
[*] More gameplay balancing and tuning.
[*] Significantly improved cutscene animations.
[*] Other minor bug fixes
[/list]
The lighthouse needs keepers.  Get to it!

Keep the light burning.  Always!

notes.title: Beacon's Bluff is out now!
notes.content:
Beacon's Bluff is a 2D narrative driven horror adventure point-and-click game. Keep the beacon's light alive and survive your shift by solving intriguing puzzles.

Become engrossed in this discerning horror adventure game -- Beacon's Bluff is the first in the Story Machine Shorts series. 

​Snag it now. We hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Stove Puzzle
notes.content:
[h1]First look at new puzzle[/h1]

[img]https://media1.giphy.com/media/bs20malKYHkuLEDCYD/giphy.gif[/img]

A rickety old stove sits in the shadows, its mouth agape, hungry for firewood. But, this fire-breathing beast is picky - the logs must be arranged in a very particular order (randomized each time). Watch closely. The ghostly whispers in the wind carry hints. Can you remember the order amidst the howls?

Beacon's Bluff launches later this month!

notes.title: Two new Beacon's Bluff puzzle shots
notes.content:
What mystifying presence manipulated the picture frames in the lighthouse? And what sinister action occurred at the pump house?! Here are two new slick (still not final) shots of "frames" and the "pump house" in Beacon's Bluff!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43679181/869d3efbc7a0a611ec2d950976f1c71721d3f815.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43679181/6ef247000916cf18e015a7638d761c1d46161bbe.png[/img]

Beacon's Bluff is one of the first games built with [url=https://www.trystorymachine.com/]Story Machine[/url], a no-code, AI-infused, cross-platform 2D game engine for narrative games. Using AI has been particularly useful. The concept and pre-production art for "frames" and "pump house" were created using generative AI, then passed to our art team to create production assets. Using AI lets us parallelize previously serial phases of game development, and massively improve our concept to production cycles. 

We'll be back soon with another update. Beacon's Bluff is really coming along nicely and we think it'll be something you really enjoy!

Robot Invader team
